descriptionHtml:
WD My Passport 4TB Portable External Hard Drive

Keep your digital life secure and close at hand with the slim-profile WD My Passport 4TB portable external hard drive, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Re-imagined with a sleek, compact form factor that fits comfortably in the palm of your hand, this reliable storage companion offers massive capacity to store, organize, and share your photos, videos, music, and critical documents. Powered by high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 1 connectivity, it delivers rapid file transfers while remaining perfectly backwards compatible with older USB ports. Designed to maximize your data security, it comes equipped with built-in 256-bit AES hardware encryption and password protection via downloadable Western Digital discovery software, alongside automated backup management profiles. This highly dependable portable travel drive comes backed by a 1-year warranty setup.
